purpose: Repair the P-116 ceiling effect and measure the independent outcome and cost contribution of the core governance scaffold, the Review chain, and Evolution before changing default governance policy.

experiment.workspaceIsolation: one external OS-temp workspace per trial, with trial-scoped AGENTS.md instructions, an independent Git root, and an immutable starter commit
experiment.codexBackend: the project's native Codex CLI runtime; no Docker, WSL, or alternate provider
experiment.codexApprovalReviewer: auto_review, the native Codex headless path that preserves on-request approval instead of forcing approval_policy=never
experiment.codexWritableRootBinding: --cd points to an external per-trial Git repository with an immutable starter commit; it is the single runtime workspace root and receives no duplicate --add-dir or repository-wide extra writable root
experiment.liveHostRequirement: run from a standalone PowerShell outside Codex Desktop; managed CODEX_THREAD_ID or CODEX_PERMISSION_PROFILE markers fail closed before any trial workspace is created
experiment.hostParityPolicy: all experiment groups use the same native Codex binary, auth, model, OS sandbox, controlled capability inventory, task, scoring, and budget; only the assigned governance scaffold changes
experiment.controlledRuntimeLoadout: ignore user config and exec rules; disable user/project hooks, plugin hooks, plugins, apps, and tool search for every group; record unavoidable shared host inventory signals as a validity hazard instead of hiding them
experiment.resumePolicy: completed trial result files are immutable and reused only when contract, scenario, trial, seed, and provider identity match

blindEvaluation.method: five held-out requirement-linked behavior checks plus a combined held-out outcome command
blindEvaluation.implementationSpecificChecksAllowed: only when the visible task explicitly requires the security primitive
blindEvaluation.reason: P-135 must increase discrimination without rewarding a preferred patch shape or changing the grader after seeing new trial outputs.

costOnlyFallback.reason: A ceiling task remains informative when every group reaches the same perfect outcome but governance produces a predeclared material cost spread; this observes cost and imposes no task budget or timeout failure.

componentDecisionPolicy.preservationBoundary: remove_from_default_scaffold changes only default application policy; it must not delete a canonical stage, runtime-native ability, skill, tool, validator, or historical evidence

mustNotClaim: global removal of an eight-stage spine stage
component benefit from fixture or partial pilot evidence
outcome benefit when all groups pass or fail identically; a predeclared all-success cost-only fallback may prove overhead but never quality benefit
